title: Theo Parnell
summary: A former member of Aaron Keener's team who is named as the first target in Year 6 Season 2 and appears in the Warlords of New York Tombs mission capture.

claims.text: Ubisoft's Year 6 Season 2 overview identifies Theo Parnell as the first former Keener team member Agents must secure.
The Raigulus direct capture labels The Tombs as a Warlords of New York mission segment and shows its Theo Parnell encounter.

paragraphs.text: The Tombs is the recorded Warlords of New York mission context for Parnell in the archive capture. A later official season places him among Keener's former team members and makes him its first named target.

verification.notes: The entry distinguishes the recorded Warlords encounter from later seasonal narrative. Detailed biography and current status require a dedicated evidence pass.
